name: Joe Nasr Public Game Development Archive
description: Verified public game prototypes, alternate builds and development records by Joe Nasr that are kept separate from the current published Games catalog.

item.name: BMX Xtreme 3D
item.description: Browser BMX racing game built around procedural tracks, jumps and arcade physics.

item.name: Kids Memory Match
item.description: Child focused browser memory matching game. Duplicate development repositories are consolidated into this lineage.

item.name: The Memory Game: Tap N# in Order
item.description: Browser memory game about remembering and tapping numbered targets in the correct order.

item.name: Hero Mission: The Healthy Choice
item.description: Educational browser quiz game for children about drug, vaping, medicine and peer-pressure safety choices. The kids-hero-quest repository is an alternate build of this same lineage.

item.name: Find Your Destiny
item.description: Child focused browser question-and-choice game with a magic-orb result interface.

item.name: Life and Origins
item.description: Browser alchemy and discovery game where players combine elements to reveal new results.

item.name: Safety Champion Adventure
item.description: Child focused browser game built around safety learning and interactive challenges.

item.name: Hero Academy: Healthy Plate
item.description: Child focused browser game about food and healthy-plate choices.

item.name: Kindness Drive
item.description: Child focused browser game built around kindness and positive social choices.

item.name: A Smarter Me!
item.description: Child focused browser quiz and choice game.

item.name: ERGO-MATIC
item.description: Educational browser board and quiz game about ergonomics.

item.name: Hangman
item.description: Browser word game project with 2D and 3D presentation variants.

item.name: Threadbound
item.description: Browser puzzle-platform prototype built around recorded movement, recall triggers and ghost replay.

item.name: AI Garden VR
item.description: Experimental gamified browser prototype with creatures, progression and learning-themed interactions. The current prototype does not train a machine-learning model.

item.name: AI Millionaire Studio
item.description: Quiz game prototype represented publicly by a partial source archive rather than a complete current playable build.

item.name: STRESS BUSTER 3000
item.description: Browser arcade interaction game built around punching on-screen targets; a WebXR repository is an alternate build of the same lineage.

item.name: Flyby
item.description: Procedural browser flight simulation game with cockpit-style HUD, continuous movement and generated terrain or flight space.

item.name: Word Finder
item.description: Bilingual English and Arabic browser word-search game for children with progressive grids and touch interaction.

item.name: Stickman's Homework
item.description: Minimal notebook-styled browser platformer combining movement with math challenges.

item.name: Signal Cities
item.description: Experimental Three.js puzzle game that turns authorized live city streams into an eight-step signal-matching challenge.
